name: live collection iterator helpers preserve chained state
source: function main():void { const m = new Map<string,number>(); m.set("a",1); m.set("b",2); const a:any=m; console.log([...a.keys()].join(","), [...a.values()].join(","), [...a].length); const i:any=a.keys().map((x:any)=>x+"!"); console.log(i.next().value, [...i].join(",")); }
